units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:1">Kel. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>מטמא במ׳</he>, makes unclean by contact.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 6:4">Toh. VI, 4</cite> <he>ספק מַגַּע טומאה וכ׳</he> a doubt as to having touched an unclean thing is judged in favor of uncleanness; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70a:12">Ab. Zar. 70ᵃ</cite>, a. e.—<he>מַגַּע נכרי</he> wine touched by a gentile suspected of idolatrous manipulations.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 69a:12">Ib. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ חבירו</he> another ignorant man’s touching things kept in levitical cleanness; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַגָּעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:18">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᵈ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="M00321"><he>מִדָּף</he></cite>.—Constr. <he>מַגָּעֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:7:9">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מ׳ זבין</he> those unclean through contact with gonorrhoeists.
